t: This Luceco FType flat bezel provides a sleek and unobtrusive finish for downlight installations. Its slim design and brushed steel colour integrate seamlessly into modern interiors, making it ideal for professional electricians and decorators working on new builds or renovations. The robust polycarbonate construction ensures durability, while the convenient twist-lock feature allows for quick and secure fitting, especially useful when decorating or painting ceilings. This 90 mm diameter bezel is compatible with Luceco FType Essence, FType Mk2, and FType Ultra downlights.
b: Slim Design Offers Unobtrusive & Modern Finish
Compatible with Luceco FType Essence & Mk2
Compatible with Luceco FType Ultra Downlights
Ideal for Decorating & Painting Ceiling Projects
